Terms and conditions

The rules of the game, written simply. They apply to all services, together with the order summary.

1. Purpose

These terms apply to every order placed with Alex & Co: building a website, subscription, options, extras and related services. They complement the order summary, which sets out the type of website, the options, the extras and the prices.

2. Ordering online

Ordering takes place on the website, in three steps: choosing the website, its options and extras, entering contact details, then secure payment. Before paying, the client sees a full summary, with the amount paid that day and the amounts that follow.

By clicking "Order and pay", the client accepts these terms and places a firm order. They immediately receive a confirmation email with an order reference, to quote in all correspondence.

An order can also be placed by email or by message. It is then firm when the client accepts the summary in writing and makes the first payment.

3. Prices

Prices are in euros. VAT is not applicable (article 293 B of the French General Tax Code) as long as the business qualifies for the VAT exemption. If this changes, the displayed prices are updated. Orders already placed keep their price.

The offer is the same for all clients. It comes down to two prices: building the website, paid once, and the subscription, paid as long as the website is hosted by Alex & Co.

Building the website costs €500. This price is the same for a single-page website and for a showcase website of up to five pages. It includes the mock-up, the complete website and putting it online.

The online shop costs €200 more, so €700 for the build. This supplement includes card payment, order tracking, putting up to 20 products online and a basic set of terms of sale that the client completes.

Build options are paid once, on top of the build price:

  • English translation, €100: the website translated into English and proofread, with a button to switch language.
  • Appointment booking, €100: a calendar on the website, where visitors book a slot from those the client opens.
  • Moving over your old website, €100: the text, photos and page addresses of the client’s old website, carried over into the new one.
  • Five more pages, €100: five pages on top of the five included, for a showcase website or an online shop.

The subscription costs €10 a month, or €100 a year (article 5). Extras paid monthly can be added to it, as well as on-demand extras, paid once (article 6).

A bigger website, or a request outside this scope, is subject to a quote that the client accepts before work begins.

4. Paying for the build

The build price is paid in two stages.

  • When ordering: a deposit of 25% of the build price, including the online shop if there is one. Build options are paid in full that day.
  • When the website is delivered: the rest, in one go.
  • Or, at delivery, in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments: the rest is split into 6 or 12 monthly instalments, as the client chooses. The subscription is then paid monthly. Each instalment is rounded down to the cent: the total never exceeds the website price. Payments stop automatically after the last instalment.

When ordering, the client chooses to pay the rest in one go or in instalments.

Example for a €500 website: the client pays €125 when ordering. At delivery, they pay €375 in one go, or €62.50 a month for 6 months, or €31.25 a month for 12 months.

5. Subscription

The subscription is required: Alex & Co does not host any website without a subscription. There is only one, the same for every website. It starts when the website is delivered.

It includes:

  • The domain name, registered in the client’s name and renewed every year (article 9).
  • Hosting for the website, with HTTPS.
  • Updates and backups for the website.
  • Website monitoring: we check that it keeps working properly.
  • Support: a reply within 72 working hours (article 11).
  • The SEO basics: the website is built so that Google can read and understand it.
  • Les outils automatisés de base : l’assistante, le gardien et le bricoleur (article 15).
  • 100 points d’énergie par mois, pour les outils de l’espace client et les retouches automatiques (article 12).
  • One change by Alex per quarter (article 11). A client who signed up before 16 November 2026 keeps one change by Alex per month.
  • The client area and its tools (article 13).

The subscription is charged in advance, every month or every year depending on the period chosen by the client. Yearly, it costs €100: the client pays for 10 months out of 12, so 2 months free. The client can switch from monthly to yearly, or from yearly to monthly, at renewal.

Payments are handled by Stripe, by bank card or SEPA direct debit. Alex & Co does not see or store bank details. Each invoice is sent by email and remains available in the client area.

If a payment fails, the client is notified by email. If nothing is settled within 30 days, the website may be paused until payment.

6. Monthly extras and on-demand extras

An extra is an additional service. There are two kinds: monthly extras and on-demand extras. No extra is required.

Monthly extras. They are paid monthly with the subscription.

  • Google follow-up, €10 a month: SEO work carried out every month, with a review of the results.
  • Detailed figures, €5 a month: the website’s figures hour by hour, and a report every month.
  • Business email address, €3 a month: an email address on the client’s domain name.
  • Stock management, €5 a month: the shop’s stock, counted down with each sale. For online shops only.
  • Customer accounts, €5 a month: an account for each shop customer, with their orders and addresses. For online shops only.

Chaque extra au mois ajoute l’outil automatisé qui lui correspond (article 15). L’extra Suivi Google s’appelait auparavant « SEO suivi ». Seul le nom change.

The client adds or removes a monthly extra whenever they like, from their client area. The new price applies from the next billing date. When the subscription is paid yearly, monthly extras are too, with the same 2 months free.

On-demand extras. They are paid once, per item.

  • An extra change by Alex, €5: a change made by hand by Alex, on top of the change included for the period (article 11).
  • Your request within 24 hours, €5: the request is taken on ahead of the others and handled within 24 hours, Monday to Friday.
  • Un article écrit et publié, 15 € : le client choisit le sujet, un outil automatisé prépare un premier jet, Alex le relit, l’illustre et le publie sur le site du client.
  • A 30-minute catch-up with Alex, €15: a meeting with Alex, by phone or video call, to review the website and the client’s projects.

The client orders an on-demand extra themselves from their client area, whenever they need one. They see the price and give their approval before each order. The amount is added to their next invoice. A client who orders nothing pays nothing more.

7. Commitment, cancellation and end of the subscription

The subscription has no commitment. The client can stop it at any time by email or by message: the button is in their client area. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid.

One exception: when the rest of the build price is paid in instalments, the client commits for the payment period, so 6 or 12 months from delivery of the website. If they stop earlier, the rest of the build price becomes due in one go. Once the website is paid for, the subscription has no commitment.

The end of the subscription ends the extras and the hosting of the website by Alex & Co. The client receives their website as files (text, images, pages), to host it wherever they like. The domain name belongs to them: they can transfer it to the provider of their choice. Hosting by Alex & Co stops 30 days after the end of the subscription.

8. Right of withdrawal

A client ordering remotely has 14 days to withdraw, without giving a reason. A message through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/en/contact/) is enough.

When ordering, the client expressly requests, by ticking the box provided, that the build starts straight away. If they withdraw within these 14 days, they pay for the work already done, pro rata to the build price. The domain name already registered stays at their cost, as it is registered in their name for one year.

9. Domain name

The client is the holder of their domain name. Alex & Co is listed as technical contact, so it can manage it. The name is registered after the first payment, if it is still available at that time.

The price of a standard .fr, .com, .net or .org domain name is included in the subscription, annual renewal included. Other extensions and so-called “premium” names, sold at a higher price by the registries, are subject to a quote.

If the client already owns a domain name, they can transfer it to Alex & Co or keep it with their provider and point it to the website. Alex & Co sends them the settings to apply.

10. Building the website and timescales

The client provides their text, photos and information, or prepares them with Alex & Co from their explanations. The timescales given (one-page website: 3 to 5 days, showcase website: 1 to 2 weeks, online shop: 2 to 3 weeks) are a guide. They run from receipt of these items. The client sees their website before it goes live and can ask for adjustments to what was ordered.

11. Changes and response time

The client sends their change requests from their client area or by message. A change is a specific edit to an existing page: a text, a price, opening hours, a photo, a product. A new page or a bigger website is subject to a quote.

For each request, the client chooses who handles it:

  • Retouche automatique : la modification est préparée par le bricoleur, un des outils automatisés d’Alex & Co (article 15). Le client voit l’aperçu, et le site n’est modifié qu’après sa validation. La retouche utilise des points d’énergie (article 12).
  • Alex: the change is made by hand, checked and set up by Alex.

Retouches automatiques. Elles couvrent les petites et moyennes modifications : un budget de mots et d’images par demande, sur une seule page. La modification est mise en ligne dès que le client valide l’aperçu, en général dans les 5 minutes qui suivent la demande. Une demande trop grande pour une retouche automatique est transmise à Alex. Elle compte alors comme une intervention d’Alex.

Change by Alex. The subscription includes one change by Alex per quarter, made by hand. For a client who signed up before 16 November 2026, it is one change per month, on the same terms. An unused change does not carry over to the next period.

An extra change by Alex. When the change for the period has already been used, the client can order an extra change by Alex, for €5 (article 6). This on-demand extra replaces the “Boost”, at the same price. The client gives their approval for each order, and the amount is added to their next invoice. They can also choose to postpone their request to the next period.

Annulation. Une demande peut être annulée gratuitement par le client dans les 24 heures qui suivent son envoi, depuis son espace client, dans la limite de trois annulations par mois : elle n’est alors pas décomptée, les points d’énergie utilisés sont rendus, et ce qui avait été mis en ligne est remis comme avant. Au-delà, l’annulation se demande à Alex.

Response time. Alex & Co replies to every request within 72 hours, on working days. This time is the same for all clients. Replying means taking on the request and giving a date. Small changes are usually done within this time. With the on-demand extra “Your request within 24 hours” (article 6), the request is handled within 24 hours, Monday to Friday.

12. Énergie

Les outils de l’espace client, les retouches automatiques et la bulle d’aide utilisent de l’énergie. C’est un compteur, affiché dans l’espace client. Les outils sont par exemple : publier sur les réseaux, corriger ou traduire un texte, conseils sur une photo ou sur une page du site, et autres outils du même genre.

Énergie comprise. L’abonnement comprend 100 points d’énergie par mois, ce qui correspond à un usage normal. Ces points sont remis le 1er de chaque mois et ne se reportent pas d’un mois sur l’autre.

Retouche automatique. Une retouche automatique utilise 30 points, plus 1 point par tranche de 10 mots écrits dans la demande, plus 10 points par photo jointe. Cela fait entre 30 et 65 points par retouche.

Outils. Un outil utilise de 3 à 16 points. Ce nombre est affiché sur son bouton, avant son utilisation. Certains outils n’en utilisent aucun.

Bulle d’aide. Chaque message écrit dans la bulle utilise 1 point d’énergie, dans la limite de 40 messages par jour.

Recharge. Au-delà, le client reprend de l’énergie à l’utilisation, depuis son espace client : 100 points pour 1 €, 500 points pour 5 €, 1000 points pour 10 €. Le montant est ajouté à sa prochaine facture. Les points repris sont gardés d’un mois sur l’autre, jusqu’à leur utilisation.

Énergie rendue. Les points d’une demande sont rendus au client dans quatre cas : la demande est transmise à Alex, la mise en ligne échoue, le client refuse l’aperçu, ou le client annule sa demande dans les 24 heures.

L’énergie et les interventions d’Alex sont comptées séparément.

13. Client area and account

Un espace client est créé automatiquement à la commande, avec l’adresse e-mail du client. Il y suit sa commande, ses demandes, son abonnement, ses extras et ses factures. Il y commande les extras à la demande (article 6). Il y trouve aussi les outils de la petite bande et son compteur d’énergie, et il peut y reprendre de l’énergie (article 12). Il garde ses identifiants pour lui et prévient Alex & Co en cas de doute sur leur usage.

An account with no login for 12 months and no active subscription is deleted automatically, together with its requests and photos. The client is notified by email 30 days before. Logging in once is enough to cancel the deletion. Invoices are kept outside the account, for the period required by law.

14. Content provided by the client

The client guarantees that they have the right to use the text, images, logos and products they provide. They remain responsible for the legal information specific to their business: mandatory notices, the terms of sale of their shop, displayed prices.

15. Versions et outils automatisés

Chaque version du site est conservée et peut être restaurée sur demande.

Alex conçoit et réalise chaque site. Pour les tâches répétitives, il s’aide d’outils automatisés qu’il a programmés, présentés sur le site comme une petite bande de petits monstres. L’abonnement de base comprend l’assistante (la bulle d’aide, qui répond aux questions du client et transmet à Alex ce qui doit l’être), le gardien (les mises à jour, les sauvegardes, la sécurité et la surveillance du site) et le bricoleur (la préparation des retouches automatiques). Les outils de l’espace client sont l’écrivain et le messager. Chaque extra au mois ajoute l’outil qui lui correspond. Dans cet article, « les petits monstres » désigne l’ensemble de ces outils, bulle d’aide comprise.

Les petits monstres sont des outils automatisés, dont certains reposent sur un système d’intelligence artificielle, qui peuvent se tromper. Rien n’est publié sans l’accord du client. Alex vérifie leur travail. Les textes et les conseils que donnent les outils sont des propositions : le client les relit avant de s’en servir et reste responsable de ce qu’il publie. Ces outils ne donnent pas de conseil juridique, médical ou comptable.

16. SEO

The SEO basics are included in the subscription. The monthly work to move the website up comes under the Google follow-up extra (article 6). In both cases, SEO is an obligation of means. Alex & Co applies good practice and monitors results, without guaranteeing a given position on Google.

17. Referral and loyalty

Each client has a referral link and code in their client area. When a referred friend’s website goes live, the referrer and the referred friend each receive 1 free month of subscription, credited on the next invoice. A second website ordered by the same client gets 10% off the build. These benefits cannot be exchanged for cash.

18. Liability

Alex & Co does everything possible to keep the website available and backed up. Alex & Co cannot be held liable for an outage at the host, a registry or the payment service, nor for content provided by the client. Any compensation cannot exceed the amounts paid for the subscription over the last 12 months, unless the law provides otherwise.

19. Mediation and disputes

In case of disagreement, the client first writes through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/en/contact/): most questions are settled in a few exchanges. If the answer does not suit them, a consumer client can refer the matter free of charge to a consumer mediator: one is being appointed, and their details will be given here. French law applies.

Last updated: 16 November 2026.
